import scipy.sparse as sp
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, Qubit, transpile, assemble, Aer, execute, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister
from qiskit.chemistry.molecules import Molecule
from qiskit.circuit.library import H, CRX, CZ, CNOT
from qiskit.algorithms.optimizers import COBYLA, SLSQP
from qiskit.algorithms.vqe import VQE, VQEError, VQEStatevectorError
from qiskit.transpile import pass_through
from qiskit_aer.noise.noise_model import NoiseModel, QuantumOperation
from qiskit_aer.noise.errors.single_qubit_depolarizing import DepolarizingChannel

def vqe_hf_sto3g_cas22():
    # Initialize the HF molecule using Qiskit Chemistry
    molecule = Molecule.from_xyz_string('HF', geometry='H 0.0 0.0 0.0; F 0.0 0.0 0.917')
    basis_set = 'sto-3g'
    molecular_orbital_energy, coefficients = molecule.compute_orbitals(basis=basis_set)

    # Select the (2e, 2o) active space orbitals
    active_electrons = [4, 5, 6, 7, 8]  # 2 electrons from bonding orbitals, 2 electrons from antibonding orbitals
    active_orbitals = [coefficients[:, i].real for i in active_electrons]
    occupied_orbitals = [coefficients[:, i].real for i in active_electrons[:2]]
    virtual_orbitals = [coefficients[:, i].real for i in active_electrons[2:]]

    # Define the active-space Hamiltonian
    N = len(active_electrons)
    n_qubits = 2 * N
    qregs = [QuantumRegister(n, 'q') for n in [N, N]]
    cregs = [ClassicalRegister(n, 'r') for n in [2 * N]]

    # One- and Two-body terms
    h_1_terms = []
    h_2_terms = []

    # Define the one-body Hamiltonian (Fock matrix)
    for i, (coeff, orbital) in enumerate(zip(occupied_orbitals, active_orbitals)):
        h_1_terms.append(QuantumCircuit(*qregs[i], **{'h_1_' + str(i): coeff}))

    for i, (coeff, orbital) in enumerate(zip(virtual_orbitals, active_orbitals)):
        h_1_terms.append(QuantumCircuit(*qregs[i + N], **{'h_1_' + str(N + i): coeff}))
        for j, (coeff2, orbital2) in enumerate(zip(occupied_orbitals, active_orbitals)):
            h_2_terms.append(QuantumCircuit(*qregs[i + N], *qregs[j], **{'h_2_' + str(i + j): coeff * coeff2}))

    # Define the two-body Hamiltonian (Coulomb and exchange terms)
    for i, (coeff, orbital1) in enumerate(zip(virtual_orbitals, active_orbitals)):
        for j, (coeff2, orbital2) in enumerate(zip(virtual_orbitals, active_orbitals)):
            if i != j:
                h_2_terms.append(QuantumCircuit(*qregs[i + N], *qregs[j + N], **{'h_2_' + str(i + j + N): coeff * coeff2}))
                h_2_terms.append(QuantumCircuit(*qregs[i], *qregs[j], **{'h_2_' + str(i + N + j): coeff * coeff2}))

    # Transpile and assemble the circuits
    h_1_terms_transpiled = [pass_through(circuit) for circuit in h_1_terms]
    h_2_terms_transpiled = [pass_through(circuit) for circuit in h_2_terms]
    h_1_terms_assembled = [assemble(circuit) for circuit in h_1_terms_transpiled]
    h_2_terms_assembled = [assemble(circuit) for circuit in h_2_terms_transpiled]

    # Combine the Hamiltonian terms into a single sparse matrix
    hamiltonian = sp.block_diag(*[circuit.draw(output='csv').split('\n')[1:] for circuit in h_1_terms_assembled] +
                                 [circuit.draw(output='csv').split('\n')[1:] for circuit in h_2_terms_assembled])

    # Implement the VQE algorithm
    optimizer = SLSQP(maximizer=True)
    vqe = VQE(hamiltonian, optimizer)

    # Define the initial Ansatz
    ansatz = QuantumCircuit(*qregs[0], *qregs[1])
    ansatz.h(qregs[0][0])
    ansatz.h(qregs[1][0])
    ansatz.cx(qregs[0][0], qregs[1][0])
    ansatz.cx(qregs[0][1], qregs[1][1])

    # Bind the parameters to the qubits
    for i, q in enumerate(qregs[0]):
        ansatz.set_parameter(q, 'theta' + str(i), initial_value=np.pi / 4)
    for i, q in enumerate(qregs[1]):
        ansatz.set_parameter(q, 'theta' + str(N + i), initial_value=np.pi / 4)

    # Run the VQE simulation
    try:
        result = vqe.run(ansatz, 1, seed_initial_point=True)
    except (VQEError, VQEStatevectorError):
        return None

    # Calculate the outputs
    ground_state_energy_estimate = np.real(result.final_statevector[0])
    energy_error_against_reference = ground_state_energy_estimate - molecular_orbital_energy[active_electrons[0]] + molecular_orbital_energy[active_electrons[1]]
    chemical_accuracy_achievement = np.abs(energy_error_against_reference) / (2 * np.abs(molecular_orbital_energy[active_electrons[0]]))
    measurement_cost = len(result.data['counts'])
    qubit_count = sum([len(q) for q in qregs])
    circuit_depth = ansatz.depth()
    gate_count = sum([circuit.count_ops(CNOT) + circuit.count_ops(H) + circuit.count_ops(CRX) + circuit.count_ops(CZ) for circuit in [ansatz] + h_1_terms_assembled + h_2_terms_assembled])

    return {
        'ground_state_energy_estimate': ground_state_energy_estimate,
        'energy_error_against_reference': energy_error_against_reference,
        'chemical_accuracy_achievement': chemical_accuracy_achievement,
        'measurement_cost': measurement_cost,
        'qubit_count': qubit_count,
        'circuit_depth': circuit_depth,
        'gate_count': gate_count
    }
